scope: Question 9: graph-structure dependence of QAOA and Recursive QAOA
status: written before new experiments; exploratory extension using previous pilot results, not a preregistered study
primary: Paired degree-preserving perturbation of connected 4-regular bipartite 16-node graphs
primary_invariants: 16 nodes, 32 edges, degree 4 at every node; each switch replaces two cross-partition edges by two within-partition edges
primary_caution: Actual frustration and triangle count measured; neither is assumed monotone in rewiring count. Conditioning on successful switch construction restricts the generated ensemble.
depth_followup: 8 families at n=10; p=1,2,3; three optimizer seeds; 2400 objective calls cap for p>=2; initialized also from preceding-depth solution
noise_followup: Three n=8 graphs, ideal-trained parameters, Aer density matrix with depolarizing two-qubit error and readout error; evaluation sensitivity only, not noisy training or calibrated hardware
exact_reference: All assignments enumerated at n<=16; final decoded scores checked on original graph
statistics: Family descriptive means; primary paired changes use graph-seed cluster bootstrap, no pooling of dependent steps as independent samples
claims: No novelty or quantum advantage assumed; benchmark graphs are self-generated, not a bit-for-bit Team9 replication
